faq.q: What is the origin of Slamet?
faq.a: Slamet is associated with Arabic. Slamet is the Javanese form of Arabic سَلَامَة (salāma), meaning 'safety, well-being'. It is used as a male given name in Indonesia.
Yes — the underlying form سْلَامِت is Arabic.
Slamet can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Slamet should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Salāma is not a Quranic personal name.
